title: Decoding The Digital Fukú: Deciphering Colonial Legacies to Critically Assess ChatGPT in Dominican Education
reasoning: The paper is a critical sociotechnical assessment of ChatGPT centered on the concepts of 'digital coloniality' and 'data-centric epistemologies.' It evaluates the ethical and political implications of AI in Dominican education, making philosophical and moral considerations regarding colonial legacies and epistemic violence its primary focus.
